english.title: Brand owner or packer / filler fail to maintain and retain records of packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a producer of packaging waste who was a

(A)_[brand owner]_
(B)_[packer/filler]_

failed to maintain for each data collection period, and retain for at least 7 years after the end of that data collection period to which they related, records of information referred to in paragraphs 10(2), 10(3)(a) or 20(b) of Schedule 1 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(2) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Perchennog brand neu baciwr / llenwr wedi methu â chynnal a chadw cofnodion gwastraff pecynwaith - Cymru
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau’n gynhyrchydd gwastraff pecynwaith a oedd yn

(A)_[berchennog brand]_
(B)_[baciwr/llenwr]_

bu ichi fethu â chynnal ar gyfer pob cyfnod casglu data, a’u cadw am o leiaf 7 mlynedd wedi diwedd y cyfnod casglu data hwnnw yr oedd yn berthnasol iddo, gofnodion gwybodaeth a gyfeiriwyd atynt ym mharagraffau 10(2), 10(3)(a) neu 20(b) o Atodlen 1 drwy **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
